root_cause.text: In the AppArmor `d_namespace_path` function, appending a trailing slash to directory paths failed to write a null terminator at the final buffer index, causing subsequent string processing to read beyond the allocated memory boundary.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `buf[aa_g_path_max - 1] = '\0';` immediately after setting the slash at `buf[aa_g_path_max - 2]`, and the CVE report confirms a KASAN slab-out-of-bounds read occurring exactly at the end of the allocated 8192-byte buffer region due to the missing string termination.
